messages:
Taylor: Quick micro UX thread 1 1 - noticed two small issues in the console: 1) icon-only buttons in table row actions get a weird double focus ring in high-contrast mode; 2) toasts are stacking under the modal when both appear. Screenshot + repro steps attached.
Nina: Ugh, seen both. For the icons the focus ring is the system outline plus our custom focus-shadow. Should we prefer one?
Evan: We generally keep the custom shadow for brand consistency, but in forced-colors/high-contrast we need to fall back to system. Suggest CSS:
```
.icon-btn:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-shadow); }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .icon-btn:focus { box-shadow: none; outline: 2px solid Highlight; } }
```
Ravi: That seems reasonable. Also ensure the visible focus target meets 3:1 contrast against BG. Add a test to the design checklist.
Taylor: Good call. Also the hit area: some icon buttons are 28px visible with 32px token hit. We should standardize to token `control-hit` -> spacing-10 so touch targets are consistent.
Nina: Please add that token alias, but note tokens.md already has `control-size` and `control-padding`. Maybe add alias comment rather than new token name.
DesignBot: Note: tokens.md currently lists `control-size` and `space-10`. Adding alias `control-hit` will create discoverability for devs. Open a PR with deprecation note if planning rename.
Evan: I'll make the CSS change + token alias in a small PR. I'll include screenshots of 400/768 widths and high-contrast mode.
Taylor: Now the toast/modal stacking. Currently modal z-index is 2000 and toasts are 1800. But our modal uses a backdrop that sets isolation and the toast container is outside the modal DOM node which causes painting under the backdrop on some browsers.
Ravi: Implementation options: 1) render toasts into a top-level portal that's guaranteed above modals, or 2) ensure modal backdrop does not create a new stacking context (avoid transform/position trick), or 3) give toasts z-index higher than modals but that is brittle.
Nina: I prefer portal approach — our toast system already renders to #redwood-portal root, but some modals render into their own root for CSS isolation. We should standardize to a single global portal root for all transient UI.
Evan: Agree. I'll change modal docs to recommend not creating isolated roots unless necessary. For immediate fix I'll bump toast root to z-index: 3000 and add a regression test.
Taylor: Add a note to the console UX guidelines: toasts should never be hidden behind modal dialogs; if a toast is triggered from inside a modal, it should either appear inside the modal context or at a global level above it, depending on severity.
Ravi: Accessibility: toasts need role="status" and aria-live="polite" for non-blocking notices; critical errors should use role="alert". When toasts appear over modals, ensure focus is not stolen.
Nina: Copy tweak: change toast text from "Saved" to "Settings saved" in the console to avoid ambiguity when multiple actions happen. Small but helpful.
DesignBot: New PR #3590 created for focus + token alias. Issue #4902 opened for toast/modal stacking with label "z-index, portals, accessibility".
Evan: I'll PR token alias + CSS + docs. Can also add a tiny a11y test in CI to simulate forced-colors.
Taylor: Owners: Evan (PRs + staging), Nina (copy + tokens doc), Ravi (a11y tests). I'll review once PR lands. Please paste staging link when ready. :thumbsup:
